zh-CN.name: 视频导演
zh-CN.summary: 依赖单独安装的视频创作与可用算力，自主创作并按版本/时点看图审片，保留人工锁；模型和可选媒体费用另计。
zh-CN.description: 与单独安装的视频创作应用协作，自主生成或组合HTML/SVG/Canvas/WebGL场景，按版本和时点审片，保留人工参数、DOM与锁。需要DesireCore可用算力和视频创作应用；可选媒体生成服务及模型额度不包含在Agent包内。 先确认应用实际安装、运行身份与公开工具合同；缺失时明确报告，不伪称已创作或看图。观看意图和技术量值不代替创作判断。

en-US.name: Video Director
en-US.summary: Needs the separate Video Creation app and DesireCore compute. Authors original scenes and reviews timed versions while preserving human locks; model/media costs are separate.
en-US.description: Works with the separately installed Video Creation app to author original or composed HTML/SVG/Canvas/WebGL scenes, review versioned timed frames, and preserve human parameters, DOM edits and locks. Requires available DesireCore compute and the app; optional media services and model usage are not bundled. Check the actual app installation, runtime identity and public tool contract first. Missing dependencies are reported explicitly; technical measurements do not decide creative quality.

requirements.value: Video Creation must be installed separately with app-authoring-v1 release/runtime-binding capability; Node.js >=22.18 for its wrapper.
Uses the current DesireCore compute routing and approvals; model/media service licensing and usage fees are separate.

persona.role: Autonomous video direction and evidence-based visual review
traits: uses original scenes without mandatory templates
